authorship.model_snapshot: current Codex task model; exact deployment id not exposed to task

inspiration.relationship: Transforms f028 exact-flow accounting into a language-free sequence of conserved discrete operators whose source, destination, capacity, and settled result remain visible; fl007 topology-controlled mixing into a movable one-edge coupler and alternating phase interlock that determine which connected transfer can occur, without retaining color-mixture rules; and fl014 sliding infrastructure plus flow into a discrete rail-mounted bridge whose position is itself an exact target field, without continuous water, packed blocks, or motor-sensitive manipulation.
inspiration.structural_difference: The player operates a sparse fixed-camera cryogenic instrument by alternating between a conduit selector and a machine selector. Quantities are exact lozenge stacks inside chamfered glass chambers; capacities, check-valve directions, bridge position, phase parity, linked mirror edge, targets, budget, and audit seals are all simultaneously inspectable. There is no avatar, gravity simulation, free placement, continuous liquid, spatial maze, timing challenge, or color-combination vocabulary.
excluded_reuse: from f028: no copied container layouts, pipe puzzles, capacity numbers, water simulation, title, art, code, or level sequence
from fl007: no copied wall placement, colored liquids, mixture table, chambers, visual identity, title, art, code, or level sequence
from fl014: no copied Klotski board, sliding block silhouettes, gravity-water physics, route layout, title, art, code, or level sequence
no source-specific names, characters, text instructions, digits, cultural symbols, hidden gestures, flashing, twitch timing, continuous physics, or visual assets

mechanics.novelty_claim: One conserved quantity becomes a compact operator-induction curriculum on an inspectable glass bench: later exact targets require composing capacity-limited flow, mutable topology, directional valves, phase-gated access, simultaneous mirrored deltas, and whole-rack rotation while returning topology and phase to their specified terminal configuration.

failure_modes: estimates glass fill height instead of counting the redundant lozenge stack
confuses the upper violet target blueprint with the larger cyan live chambers
selects a conduit but forgets that the machine selector is an independent state
attempts flow through a conduit not occupied by the white rail coupler
ignores a check-valve chevron and transfers from the geometrically wrong source
uses split when the source is odd or the destination is not empty
forgets that the phase interlock opens only the matching hatch family
predicts only the selected transfer when the mirrored-header tether is present
rotates into a chamber whose gold capacity datum would be exceeded
audits before quantities, bridge position, and phase all match their visible targets

progression.new_demand: Induce the unit-drip machine, move the angular conduit selector, and conserve four lozenges while matching the upper blueprint.
Read unequal gold capacity datums and use the new flush wedge to move exactly the available amount into each rated chamber.
Advance a rail-mounted coupler so only one physical conduit is open at a time, and finish with its position matched as part of the target.
Induce the empty-destination even splitter while following an inward-facing check valve whose chevron reverses the usual source and destination.
Toggle a two-family phase interlock to expose alternating conduits, then restore the specified phase after staged unit transfers.
Use the new mirrored header so one commit applies simultaneous conserved deltas at the selected and tethered opposite conduits.
Compose capacity-aware splitting, conduit selection, coupler motion, whole-rack rotation, and a capacity-limited flush into one exact commissioning state.
Coordinate reversed check valves, alternating phase access, simultaneous mirrored flow, unequal capacities, and whole-rack rotation before the final recoverable audit.

visual_identity.silhouette_grammar: Chamfered glass chambers, alternating solid and hollow lozenge quantity stacks, triangular check valves, chevron selectors, rail bridges, paired phase coils, mirrored brackets, wedge flushers, and rotary rings replace the prototype's square bars and unlabeled rectangular buttons.
visual_identity.spatial_grammar: A sparse dark fixed-camera test bench separates a narrow violet target blueprint above from large cyan live vessels below; directional conduits and topology instruments occupy the central datum rail, asymmetric machines form a low console, and small paired audit crystals sit at the chassis edge.
visual_identity.motion_grammar: Angular brackets translate between conduits and machines, white diagnostic packets climb changed chambers, bridge trusses slide on a rail, phase coils energize in alternating banks, rotor packets orbit the rack, audits sweep linearly, and success expands as nested technical diamonds rather than organic pulses.
visual_identity.hud_grammar: One- or two-row cyan lozenge bolts expose exact remaining action budget, spent bolts collapse to steel dashes, paired violet audit crystals fracture red independently, gold chamber datums expose capacities, and dotted magenta header tethers mark coupled consequences.
